copy.headline: Dallas-bound American Airlines flight clips wings with another plane at Reagan National
copy.caption:
Two American Airlines flights taxiing for departure at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport clipped wings Friday, a spokesperson for the company said. American Airlines flight 638 bound for Dallas and flight 2152 bound for Chicago made contact with each other and returned to their respective gates.

An American Airlines spokesperson said the wingtips of the 737-800s made contact. Maintenance crews will inspect the planes.
